claims.statement: Tom Allen introduced Prof. Bauer and Herr Heygster to the audience at the Temple, St. Louis, before their second wrestling match.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen,the champion pugilist, introduced the men to the audience

claims.statement: During the recess Tom Allen announced that a silver belt, which Bauer's friends had obtained for him as champion Greco-Roman wrestler of America, would be presented to Bauer.
claims.excerpt: silver belt, which Bauer's friends had gotten

notes: Allen was only master of ceremonies (announcer) at the Bauer-Heygster match; he did not fight. Date from 'last evening' in a paper of 1876-04-09.
